name: Moneyline (with Draw)
description: Home win, draw or away win after regular time.

name: Double chance
description: Two of the three results: home or draw, home or away, draw or away.

name: Draw no bet
description: Home or away; a draw returns the stake.

name: Over/Under goals
description: Total goals over or under the line.

name: Asian handicap
description: Line applied to the home team; whole lines can push, quarter lines split the stake.

name: European handicap
description: Three-way result with a whole-goal handicap applied to the home team.

name: Home team total goals
description: Home team's goals over or under the line.

name: Away team total goals
description: Away team's goals over or under the line.

name: Total corners
description: Total corners over or under the line.

name: Total cards
description: Total yellow and red cards over or under the line (a second yellow counts as two cards: yellow plus red).

name: Anytime goalscorer
description: The player scores in regular time (own goals do not count). A player who does not play is void.
